summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K disclosing ongoing share repurchases under a buyback programme announced August 10, 2026. Between August 27 and September 2, 2026, it purchased 11.4 million shares across venues at weighted average prices from €12.50 to €12.76, cumulatively spending €305.9 million, about 16.8% of the programme's maximum. The buyback represents approximately 18.1% of outstanding shares as of 2021. The company acts as issuer returning capital to shareholders, with transactions executed on Madrid and other European exchanges. Watch for continued execution pace and potential price support.
